title: Slim the default release core to a protocol socket
goal: Measure the default release binary, then move bulk tools and the built-in local model engine out of the default build behind features that are off unless requested. Keep MCP, OpenAI-style, Anthropic Messages, and A2A ports working. Publish before/after size and time-to-ready.

criteria: Default cargo build --release -p susi does not link tools-rich (chrome, tantivy, fastembed, syn) or the Candle local engine.
cargo build --release -p susi --features plugins links those optional pieces again.
MCP, OpenAI-style /v1/chat/completions, Anthropic /v1/messages, and A2A stay in the default binary.
Before and after size and time-to-ready are recorded in the task log and the pull request.
